text: Late-night scrolling. One-tap checkout. Pay in four. And by the twentieth... your money's gone.
Six in ten of us impulse-buy because of social media. And most of us regret it.
Meet Cooldown. The app that puts a pause between you and the checkout.
Before you pay, it shows you the real price.
Hours of your work, and days added to your goals.
Tap cool down, and it holds the item for twenty-four hours.
Still want it tomorrow? Buy it, guilt-free.
Changed your mind? That money goes straight into your savings.
No spreadsheets. No guilt trips. Just fewer regrets, and goals that actually get closer.
It works with your cards and your favourite shops. And you can flex what you didn't buy.
Cooldown. Cool down before you check out. Join the free waitlist. Link in bio.
